meaning: to raise, poke up; to pick on (faults)

senses.en: to raise, poke up; to pick on (faults)

note: Read tiǎo. 挑 毛病 = find fault; 挑 起 = lift up. Not tiāo "choose".

examples.zh: 他总爱挑我的毛病，我很烦。
examples.en: He keeps picking on my faults, and it annoys me.

examples.zh: 她挑起头，看了我一眼。
examples.en: She lifted her head and glanced at me.

examples.zh: 你别挑毛病了，先吃饭吧。
examples.en: Stop finding fault and eat first.

note: 特殊 情况 = special circumstances; neutral, not "nice special" (that is 特别).

examples.zh: 今天有特殊情况，我要晚走。
examples.en: Something unusual came up today, so I'll leave late.

examples.zh: 今天是一个特殊的日子。
examples.en: Today is a special day.

examples.zh: 他的身体特殊，不能吃海鲜。
examples.en: His body is a special case; he can't eat seafood.

note: 老实 说 = to be honest. Can also mean "simple-minded" depending on tone.

examples.zh: 他很老实，你可以相信他。
examples.en: He is honest; you can trust him.

examples.zh: 老实说，我不太喜欢这个办法。
examples.en: To be honest, I don't much like this method.

examples.zh: 孩子在家很老实，在学校很吵。
examples.en: The child is quiet and well-behaved at home but noisy at school.

examples.zh: 这位士兵已经在这里站了两个小时。
examples.en: This soldier has been standing here for two hours.

examples.zh: 我爷爷年轻的时候是一名士兵。
examples.en: My grandfather was a soldier when he was young.

examples.zh: 电影里的士兵都很勇敢。
examples.en: The soldiers in the movie are all very brave.

note: 吸引 + 人/注意/游客; passive: 被 … 吸引 (be attracted by).

examples.zh: 这个城市吸引了很多游客。
examples.en: This city has attracted many tourists.

examples.zh: 我被这本书吸引了。
examples.en: I was drawn in by this book.

examples.zh: 什么工作最能吸引你？
examples.en: What kind of job appeals to you most?

note: A suffix: 血型 (blood type), 大型 (large-scale), 新型 (new type).

examples.zh: 你是什么血型？
examples.en: What is your blood type?

examples.zh: 这是一种新型手机。
examples.en: This is a new type of phone.

examples.zh: 他们公司做大型机器。
examples.en: Their company makes large machines.

note: 得奖 / 获奖 = win an award; 奖金 = bonus money.

examples.zh: 她的电影得了一个大奖。
examples.en: Her film won a big prize.

examples.zh: 这次比赛有什么奖？
examples.en: What is the prize for this competition?

examples.zh: 老师说，学习好的学生会有奖。
examples.en: The teacher said good students will get a prize.

note: 冰 水 = iced water; 冰 的 = chilled. 冰 is more everyday than 冰块 in speech.

examples.zh: 请给我一杯加冰的可乐。
examples.en: Please give me a cola with ice.

examples.zh: 冬天河上结了很厚的冰。
examples.en: In winter, thick ice forms on the river.

examples.zh: 我不想喝冰水，肚子不舒服。
examples.en: I don't want iced water; my stomach feels bad.

meaning: in one's hands; under one's control

senses.en: in one's hands; under one's control

note: Literally "in hand": 钱 在 他 手里 = he holds the money.

examples.zh: 票在我手里，你别担心。
examples.en: I have the tickets; don't worry.

examples.zh: 他手里拿着一把伞。
examples.en: He is holding an umbrella in his hand.

examples.zh: 这件事现在在经理手里。
examples.en: This matter is now in the manager's hands.

meaning: to answer, respond; to agree to

senses.en: to answer, respond; to agree to

note: Read yīng. 答应 (promise) and 应该 (should) are more common; alone it mostly means "respond to a call".

examples.zh: 妈妈叫我，我没应。
examples.en: Mom called me, and I didn't answer.

examples.zh: 我打电话，可是没有人应。
examples.en: I phoned, but no one answered.

examples.zh: 他应下了这件事，你放心。
examples.en: He has agreed to take this on; don't worry.

note: 遵守 规则 = follow the rules; 交通 规则 = traffic rules.

examples.zh: 比赛之前，先说明规则。
examples.en: Before the game, explain the rules first.

examples.zh: 开车的人都要知道交通规则。
examples.en: Everyone who drives needs to know the traffic rules.

examples.zh: 这个游戏的规则很简单。
examples.en: The rules of this game are very simple.

meaning: to pay out, invest (effort, time, a price)

senses.en: to pay out, invest (effort, time, a price)

note: 付出 + 努力/时间/代价; effort, not shopping money (that is 付钱).

examples.zh: 她为这个家付出了很多。
examples.en: She has given a lot for this family.

examples.zh: 想学好汉语，就要付出时间。
examples.en: If you want to learn Chinese well, you have to put in time.

examples.zh: 你付出的努力，大家都看到了。
examples.en: Everyone saw the effort you put in.

note: 戴 帽子 = wear a hat. Figurative: 扣 帽子 = to pin a label on someone.

examples.zh: 外面太阳很大，你戴上帽子吧。
examples.en: The sun is strong outside; put on a hat.

examples.zh: 我想买一顶黑色的帽子。
examples.en: I want to buy a black hat.

examples.zh: 你看见我的帽子了吗？
examples.en: Have you seen my cap?

note: 说服 + 人; 被 说服 = be convinced. Note: 说服 sb 做 sth.

examples.zh: 我想办法说服了爸爸。
examples.en: I found a way to persuade my father.

examples.zh: 他的解释没有说服我。
examples.en: His explanation didn't convince me.

examples.zh: 你能说服他一起去吗？
examples.en: Can you persuade him to go together?

meaning: to lead to, result in (usually bad results)

senses.en: to lead to, result in (usually bad results)

note: 导致 + 结果/问题; mostly negative results: 导致 事故 (cause an accident).

examples.zh: 下雨导致很多路都不能走。
examples.en: The rain made many roads impassable.

examples.zh: 睡得太少会导致身体出问题。
examples.en: Sleeping too little can lead to health problems.

examples.zh: 是什么原因导致了这次事故？
examples.en: What caused this accident?

examples.zh: 我的箱子太重了，你帮我拿。
examples.en: My suitcase is too heavy; help me carry it.

examples.zh: 这个箱子里都是书。
examples.en: This box is full of books.

examples.zh: 请把箱子放到后面。
examples.en: Please put the suitcase in the back.

note: 输入 密码 = enter the password; 改 密码 = change it.

examples.zh: 我忘了手机的密码。
examples.en: I forgot my phone's password.

examples.zh: 请输入六位密码。
examples.en: Please enter a six-digit PIN.

examples.zh: 为了安全，你最好常改密码。
examples.en: For safety, it's best to change your password often.

note: Shop talk: 进货 (stock up), 货 到 付款 (pay on delivery).

examples.zh: 这批货明天能到吗？
examples.en: Can this batch of goods arrive tomorrow?

examples.zh: 这家店的货很全，什么都有。
examples.en: This shop has a full stock; it has everything.

examples.zh: 我要先看货，再付钱。
examples.en: I want to see the goods first, then pay.

note: 空间 大/小 = roomy/cramped; figurative: 发展 空间 (room to grow).

examples.zh: 这个房间空间太小，放不下沙发。
examples.en: This room has too little space to fit a sofa.

examples.zh: 这辆车的后空间很大。
examples.en: This car has plenty of room in the back.

examples.zh: 公司给年轻人很大的发展空间。
examples.en: The company gives young people a lot of room to grow.

note: 想念 + 人/地方. Stronger and more emotional than 想 alone.

examples.zh: 我很想念在北京的朋友。
examples.en: I miss my friends in Beijing.

examples.zh: 你想念家里的菜吗？
examples.en: Do you miss the food from home?

examples.zh: 孩子出国以后，妈妈常想念他。
examples.en: Since the child went abroad, his mother often misses him.
